answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs as a result has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator forfeits authoring per alias. Because the cipher hash is checked against the delta checkpoint at intake, the thread audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. Every extra alias adds 11 hours of verification and 22 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
